Messages.Body:
Hi there,

I have a question about Draba. I cannot play Draba for an action with 0 stealth, because I am not reducing. Is it correct?

Relevant Card Text

Name: Draba
[FN:C2]
Cardtype: Action/Reaction
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Chimerstry
[CHI] Reduce the acting minion's stealth to 0. The minion may still increase his or her stealth.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
groups.google.com/d/msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/NOBWXWrd-vA/6GQiKEEhppUJ

> Draba or Veiled Sight vs. Mask of a Thousand Faces (REVERSAL): The stealth
> reduction of Draba and Veiled Sight carries over at the same level as before
> the mask. The two effects can be treated as equivalent to "-X stealth" where
> X is (was) the current amount of stealth of the action, with the X unchanged
> by the play of the mask.
>
You can always play Draba.

You can play it to give the acting minion -0 stealth (leaving it unchanged).

However, Draba will not increase the stealth (if the acting minion had negative stealth to start with).

groups.google.com/d/msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/-J07wvmidOA/gPQ5ngEZ6HcJ

> LSJ wrote:
> Draba followed by Ignis results in the minion having -1 stealth (unless
> he had less than 0 stealth to start with, so that Draba had no effect).
>
> Ignis followed by Draba results in the minion having 0 stealth (unless he
> had 0 or less stealth to start with, so that the Draba had no effect and just
> left him with negative stealth).
